title: With EU backing, QuantumDiamonds aims to speed up chip manufacturing
slides: Can QuantumDiamonds fix your chip yield loss?
EU funding supports its quantum sensor for fab lines
The sensor detects defects no existing tool can see
Your next wafer batch might avoid costly rework
Test QuantumDiamonds' prototype before competitors do
thread_text:
1. The defect your tools miss

QuantumDiamonds' sensor detects chip flaws no existing fab tool can see. Yield loss may finally have a fix.

2. EU just backed the bet

European Union funding is now supporting development of this quantum sensor for production line integration.

3. A rework-free future

Next wafer batches could skip costly rework entirely — defects caught before they compound.

4. Prototype ready for testing

A working prototype exists. Your fab can test it now, before competitors lock in the advantage.

5. Will you test first?

Request a prototype evaluation this quarter. Do you want competitors to own the early data?
